rows.line: TCS New York City Marathon and
Abbott Dash to the Finish Line 5K
Saturday, November 1, 2025, to Sunday, November 2, 2025
The City of New York provides as much information as possible to ensure
that residents and business owners of affected areas are informed about
interruptions to normal operations. Please be aware that the TCS New York
City Marathon and Abbott Dash to the Finish Line 5K are happening on
November 1-2, 2025.
Please note the following:
Road closures and road re-openings may happen on a rolling basis
Road closures and road re-openings are subject to change without notice
Road closures and road re-openings are at the discretion of the NYPD
